name: You are more than your body and roles
meaning: The self passes through childhood, youth and old age without being any of them; the body is the field, and you are its knower.
applies_when: Someone's identity has collapsed with a role: a job lost, children leaving, an illness, retirement.
misleads_when: It is used to neglect the body or dismiss real limitations.
modern_application: Write 'I am…' ten times, then cross out every answer that could be taken away. Notice what remains.

name: Everything that comes goes
meaning: Sense experiences come and go, worlds arise and dissolve, and the tree of worldly life is always changing.
applies_when: Someone is clinging to a situation that is changing, or dreading a change that cannot be stopped.
modern_application: Name one thing you are holding tightly. Ask how you would care for it differently if you remembered it will change.

name: See birth, ageing, sickness and death clearly
meaning: Part of wisdom is seeing plainly the pain of birth, death, old age and sickness, and with that, lessening ego and attachment.
applies_when: Someone is avoiding thinking about ageing or illness, their own or a parent's, and needs to plan honestly.
misleads_when: It is used to dwell morbidly on decline, or near someone in distress.
modern_application: Have one honest conversation about future care, wishes or finances with the person it concerns.

name: Beyond the senses is the mind, beyond the mind the intellect
meaning: There is an inner order: senses, mind, intellect, the great self, and beyond them all the Self; the higher can steady the lower.
applies_when: Someone feels ruled by impulses and needs to see that there is a deeper level to stand on.
misleads_when: It is used to look down on emotions or the body as 'low'.
modern_application: When an impulse arises, ask in order: what do I sense, what do I feel, what do I actually judge best?

name: Whoever claims to know it fully does not
meaning: The deepest reality is rarely heard of, more rarely understood; whoever thinks 'I know it well' knows only a little.
applies_when: Someone, or someone they are dealing with, is certain they have the final truth about life or religion.
misleads_when: It becomes an excuse never to commit to any understanding.
modern_application: In your next disagreement about something deep, say 'I might be wrong about this' and listen for one minute longer.

name: Know what matters in this life
meaning: If one knows the truth here, life has meaning; if not, the loss is great. The Self is seen most clearly here, as in a mirror.
applies_when: Someone keeps postponing what matters most to 'later'.
misleads_when: It creates anxiety or a sense of failure in someone already struggling.
modern_application: Write the one thing you most want to have understood or done before you die. Schedule one hour for it this month.

name: Awareness is behind all experience
meaning: That which hears through the ear and thinks through the mind cannot itself be heard or thought; it is the awareness behind every experience, in waking and dream.
applies_when: Someone is overwhelmed by thoughts and feelings and needs a place to stand behind them.
misleads_when: It is used to dissociate from feelings that need attention.
modern_application: For one minute, notice that you are aware of your thoughts. Rest as that awareness rather than in the thoughts.

name: See the Self in all and all in the Self
meaning: Whoever sees all beings in the Self and the Self in all beings no longer feels aversion; the one Self takes the form of each being, like fire or wind.
applies_when: Someone feels hostility, contempt or deep separateness from others.
misleads_when: It is used to deny real differences, or to make someone tolerate harmful behaviour 'because we are all one'.
modern_application: Pick someone you dislike and list three things you share with them: fears, hopes, needs.

name: The real never ceases to be
meaning: The unreal never comes into being and the real never ceases to be; what pervades all is indestructible.
applies_when: Someone needs a steady foundation amid loss and change.
misleads_when: It is used to minimise the real suffering of loss.
modern_application: Ask what in your life has stayed true through every change. Lean on that.

name: You become what you dwell on
meaning: A person is made of their faith; whatever state one has always been absorbed in, one goes to at the end.
applies_when: Someone wants to change who they are becoming, through habits of thought and attention.
misleads_when: It produces fear about every passing thought, or blames people for intrusive thoughts.
modern_application: Look at where your attention went today. Is that who you want to become? Change one input this week.

name: The lasting is not reached by passing things
meaning: Treasure is impermanent, and what is permanent is not reached by impermanent means; the wise seek nothing lasting among unstable things.
applies_when: Someone hopes possessions, status or achievement will finally give them security or meaning.
misleads_when: It is used to dismiss saving, planning or caring for material needs.
modern_application: Next to each big goal, write what you hope it will give you inside. Ask whether there is a more direct way to that.

name: Remember mortality
meaning: The body will end in ashes; at the end, the seeker asks the mind to remember what was done, and mortals ripen like grain.
applies_when: An adult wants perspective on priorities, using awareness of death to choose what matters.
misleads_when: It is brought up with someone grieving, frightened, in distress or under 18. Restricted.
modern_application: Ask: if I had one year, what would I stop doing, and what would I start?
